summary.text: Matt Beck (listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Beck) is a Democratic state representative who has represented Maine House District 122 since March 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously worked as a television producer and director and as an electrical workers union organizer.

paragraphs.text: Beck grew up on Long Island, New York, and moved to Maine in 1987.
He received a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York at Binghamton.
His career experience includes working as a television producer and director and as an International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers union organizer.
Beck took office in the Maine House on March 6, 2024, succeeding Lois Reckitt, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
